goal: Validate and resize bundle core and add-on compositions against opaque CompositionConstraint envelopes (bundle rules, composition constraints, resizing).
whyThisDefault: The platform stores CompositionConstraint envelopes without interpreting them; bundle writes skip constraint validation when no CompositionRulesPort from @openlup/core/bundle is supplied or the constraint is empty.

effect.appliesTo: New bundle composition writes and subscription package edits evaluate the bound CompositionRulesPort from @openlup/core/bundle when validating or resizing constrained compositions.
frozenOn: Saved bundle versions, active product facts, and existing subscription templates retain their stored compositions until edited.

runtime.reason: The callbacks are executable server code implementing CompositionRulesPort from @openlup/core/bundle.
The media contract admits a fixed set of validated formats.

goal: Set the whole-bundle low-stock threshold and whether optional add-on components limit derived bundle stock (bundle low stock, bundle availability, add-on stock).
whyThisDefault: A three-bundle cutoff reflects multi-unit consumption per bundle, and excluding optional add-ons prevents optional extras from marking core bundles unsellable.

effect.appliesTo: BundleAvailabilityServiceDeps (lowStockThreshold default 3, includeAddonsInStock default false) and DeriveBundleAvailabilityInput in @openlup/platform/catalog. Controls derived bundle status and whether add-on components constrain sellableNow. Non-integer or negative lowStockThreshold values reject at runtime.
frozenOn: Saved bundle compositions, placed orders, and active reservations retain their recorded stock state.

runtime.reason: Passed in BundleAvailabilityServiceDeps / DeriveBundleAvailabilityInput (@openlup/platform/catalog) and applied on deployment.

goal: Represent product net contents in units other than grams.

runtime.reason: The catalogue read envelope uses grams for net contents.

goal: Use catalogue SKUs that have no GTIN.

runtime.reason: Native catalogue identities require a unit trade identifier. For a SKU without a globally assigned GTIN, see the internal number recipe in Products and trade items.
